prompt: As of August 3, 2024, how much taller was the tsunami wave of the most powerful earthquake in North America than the most powerful earthquake ever recorded in Japan?
answer:
The 1964 Great Alaska earthquake—the most powerful recorded in North America—produced a maximum tsunami run-up of about **67 m (220 ft)**. Japan’s most powerful recorded earthquake, the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake, produced a maximum run-up of about **40.5 m (133 ft)**.

Thus, the North American tsunami was approximately **26.5 m (87 ft) taller**.
